baseline_description: Marks the reference run (baseline) of the workspace and compares a run with it: set, clear, show, compare.
baseline_unknown_subcommand_fix: Use: jgates baseline set <runId> | clear | show | compare <runId>.
baseline_missing_run_fix: See the ids with jgates history.
baseline_run_not_found: Run not found in this workspace: {runId}
baseline_run_not_found_fix: See the runs with jgates history.
baseline_run_unfinished: The run {runId} did not finish; it cannot be a baseline.
baseline_run_unfinished_fix: Mark a run that has a final result.
baseline_no_baseline_fix: Mark one with jgates baseline set <runId>.
baseline_not_comparable: Warning: the comparison is not like for like ({codes}).
